info.title: VaaniEHR API
info.description: Research prototype. Simulated data only. Standalone mode: access token about 1 hour, no refresh token (ADR-D4). Generated from the route registry; do not edit by hand (npm run openapi).

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password; returns a ~1 h access token (no refresh token)

get.summary: The signed-in user (read from the directory on every call)

post.summary: Find a patient by phone number (POST so the number is never in a URL)
Register a patient (an existing phone number in the clinic returns the existing patient)

get.summary: Read a patient and their allergy list

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

put.summary: Replace the patient allergy list (free text entries)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Open a consultation session for a patient (the caller becomes the session doctor)

get.summary: The signed-in doctor's OWN sessions in their clinic, newest first (never another doctor's), with the patient's name and a consent summary.
Read a session with its current consent state

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

get.summary: The consent notice for a version in BOTH languages in one response (en and gu), for side-by-side display. Placeholder markers and the Gujarati needsReview flag are part of the payload.
Current effective consent for a session, plus the event history

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Record consent for one or more scopes (audio, ai_processing, whatsapp)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Withdraw consent (all granted scopes, or the listed ones). Always allowed while the session exists.

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Doctor: get a 120-second token to stream audio to the speech service; refused unless audio and AI-processing consent are on record

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

get.summary: This clinic's audit log, newest first, with optional user, action and date filters. Admin sees full rows; researcher sees anonymised rows (and cannot filter by user). Rows with no clinic are not shown.

post.summary: Export this clinic's audit rows (same filters as the list) as CSV, newest first, at most 5000 rows. Identifiers only; spreadsheet formulas are neutralised. The export is itself written to the audit log.

200.description: CSV file (RFC 4180). Text cells that could run as spreadsheet formulas are neutralised.

get.summary: Re-compute the whole hash chain and report whether it is intact. The chain is shared by all clinics, so the answer carries no row counts or hashes; use `npm run verify:audit` for those.
Search medicines by generic or brand name (case-insensitive, English or Gujarati); generic names rank first. Without q: alphabetical list.

post.summary: Admin: add a medicine (a source is required; it starts as not reviewed)

get.summary: The top-level categories (NLEM sections) with the number of medicine rows in each
Read one medicine with its source, review status and brands

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

patch.summary: Admin: edit a medicine. An edit clears any review (reviewed_on / reviewed_by become empty). Codes and review fields cannot be set here.

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Admin: retire a medicine (it is hidden from search; rows are never deleted)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)
Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Admin: add a brand name to a medicine (optional child; a source is required)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Admin: retire a brand name (brands are never deleted)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

get.summary: List the templates the caller may see: their own and the clinic-wide ones of their clinic

post.summary: Create a template (personal or clinic-wide) with at least one item

get.summary: Read one template with its ordered items

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

put.summary: Replace a template (name, visibility, items). Its owner may edit it; an admin may edit a clinic-wide one; only the owner can change its visibility.

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

get.summary: Load a template: its items in order, ready to drop into a prescription. An item whose medicine has been retired is returned and flagged (MEDICINE_RETIRED), never dropped or replaced.

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)

post.summary: Retire a template (hidden from the default list and not loadable; never deleted)

404.description: Not found (or not visible to the caller)
Not found (or not visible to the caller)
